info.title: Steel API v1 (contract fixture)
info.description: Hand-written fixture shaped after docs/cli/README.md of the Steel repo. Used to generate the SDK until the app publishes public/openapi.v1.json. Only the routes the CLI consumes are described, trimmed to the fields it reads.

post.summary: Exchange an approved device code for a personal token

200.description: Approved: the personal token (returned only once)

get.summary: The user, workspace and token behind the current personal token
Catalog of the webhook events Steel sends

201.description: Endpoint and its signing secret (returned only here)

post.summary: Send a steel.ping to one endpoint now (api:write)
Queue one more attempt of a delivery (api:write)

get.summary: Server-Sent Events with the workspace's webhook events (steel listen)
get.description: First `event: ready` with WebhookListenReady, then `event: webhook` (id = event id) with WebhookListenFrame for each event, and a `: ping` comment every 25 s.

parameters.name: events
parameters.description: Comma-separated event types; empty means all

post.summary: Create a test event of a catalog type (steel trigger, api:write)

get.summary: List tickets (open ones unless `status` says otherwise)
One ticket by id or number

post.summary: Add a public or internal comment
Move a ticket to another phase
Import up to 5,000 leads from a CSV
Move an opportunity to another stage

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the device code expires

deliveries.description: Endpoint deliveries queued (0 when only listeners get it)

WebhookListenReady.description: Data of the first SSE message (event: ready) of /api/v1/webhooks/listen

events.description: Filter in effect; empty means all

secret.description: Signing secret of this member's listen feed

WebhookListenFrame.description: Data of each SSE message (event: webhook): the exact body and the three Steel-Webhook-* header values

body.description: Exact JSON body of the event

components.description: Template components as the Meta Graph API returns them (HEADER, BODY, FOOTER, BUTTONS).

WhatsAppTemplateSend.description: Target: `conversationId`, or `contactId` + `connectionId`, or `to` (phone, digits with country code; `connectionId` optional). `to` is a cli-domain addition to the contract.
